title: First There Was a Tree, Now For an Upgrade!
description:
A crafting table is an excellent and vital block for sure, but you can only do so much with a 3x3 grid. Many times, you'll find you need something heated. That's where §o§6The Furnace§r comes into play. You'll want to have mined a ring of stone to craft it, and an entire world of possibilities will open for you. Will you cook? Smelt? Perhaps do more? I, Professor Larch, am excited to find out, even if this is a book I've pre-written for you.
In addition to this, it's probably about time we get that upgrade mentioned prior. A §istone pickaxe§r will do nicely, made the same way as your old wooden one.
